eventDetail.scope: PSGAI 2026 focuses on the integration of power systems, smart grids, and artificial intelligence to improve energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability. It covers power system control, renewable energy integration, intelligent grid optimization, and AI-driven forecasting, aiming to enhance grid resilience and support the transition to low-carbon, digital energy systems.
